environment.description: Same Spring Boot application and imgconvert binary deployed in a container orchestrated by ECS Fargate. The task definition specifies a custom readonly root filesystem with a tmpfs mount at /data/uploads. The container entry uses pivot_root into /srv/jail which contains only the JRE runtime, the imgconvert binary, and the tmpfs upload directory — no /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /proc/self/environ, or credential files exist within the filesystem namespace. The ECS task role has no attached policies (arn:aws:iam::*:role/image-processor-task-role with zero inline or managed policies). The VPC security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) has egress rules limited to port 443 to the ECR VPC endpoint only (pl-63a5400a), blocking all other outbound including 169.254.169.254. The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 places the task in an isolated network namespace where the IMDS link-local route is not present. Additionally, the container runs with a seccomp profile that allows only: read, write, open, close, stat, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, clone, execve, exit_group, wait4, fcntl, getdents, getcwd, chdir, rename, unlink, readlink, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, arch_prctl, futex, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, socket, connect, sendto, recvfrom, bind, listen, accept — but NOT mprotect with PROT_EXEC on stack pages (filtered via seccomp BPF arg inspection), preventing shellcode execution on the stack even though the binary was compiled with -z execstack.

config.security_group_egress: 443 to ECR VPC endpoint prefix list only
config.seccomp_profile: custom BPF filtering mprotect(PROT_EXEC) on stack addresses
